notes.text:
This update for python-pyasn1 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-23490: Fixed malformed RELATIVE-OID with excessive continuation 
  octets leading to Denial of Service (bsc#1256902)

notes.text: pyasn1 is a generic ASN.1 library for Python. Prior to 0.6.2, a Denial-of-Service issue has been found that leads to memory exhaustion from malformed RELATIVE-OID with excessive continuation octets. This vulnerability is fixed in 0.6.2.
